title: Elastic fader
description: An orange level control stretches against its limits and settles back around a brushed-metal fill.
useCase: Bounded continuous input with tactile overtravel.
interaction: Drag the level past either endpoint, or use arrow keys.
reducedMotion: The level changes immediately; shell deformation is removed.
limitations: A local 0–100 level, not an audio mixer.
look: Saturated orange panel with an oversized black level number, monospace scale labels and a vertical black fader track holding a brushed-metal fill and silver cap.
motion: Dragging sets the level directly; pulling past either end stretches the track with logarithmic resistance up to 26%, and on release it springs back with a 380 ms overshooting cubic-bezier.
adapt: Overtravel is computed in `update`: values beyond 0–100 become a `Math.log1p` stretch times `0.045`, capped at `0.26` and applied as `scaleY` on `.sf-ef-shell` from `stretchOrigin`. Tune the `380ms cubic-bezier(.18,1.5,.35,1)` return; wire `value` to your setting.
